title: BUGFIX — avatar-presenter: use /submit+/poll instead of broken /avatarVideoFromUrl (404)
rationale: createAvatarJob in avatar-presenter.ts calls https://api.captions.ai/api/creator/avatarVideoFromUrl which returns 404 (detail: Not Found). The correct endpoint pattern is /submit + /poll (confirmed working 2026-03-23, also used by generateAvatarVideo). Fix: replace createAvatarJob + pollJobStatus calls in generateAvatarSegments with a direct call to generateAvatarVideo, which handles submit->poll->download internally using the working endpoints.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/avatar-presenter.ts: replace createAvatarJob+pollJobStatus+downloadVideo call in generateAvatarSegments with generateAvatarVideo (uses /submit+/poll, confirmed working).
